blurb: Nehoiden Golf Course is a private, 9 hole course, one of the oldest college courses in the country, dating back to 1893. The course is open dawn to dusk, mid-April through late fall, weather permitting, and is closed Monday until noon for maintenance except on Monday holidays. Tee times are required; motorized carts are not allowed but pull carts are available for rent.
